name: Halvard the Coinhand

abilities.name: Riposte (Reaction)
abilities.description: When a creature within 5 feet of Halvard misses it with a melee attack roll, Halvard makes one Handaxe attack against that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Halvard makes three Handaxe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shortsword.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. Until the end of Halvard's next turn, Halvard has advantage on attack rolls against the target, and the target can't take the Hide action.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. Immediately after the attack, a handaxe returns to Halvard's grasp, and Halvard has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: One creature within 5 feet that Halvard can see must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage on a failed save. On a failed save, if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

generation.userConcept: a sellsword who hurls a handaxe and closes with a shortsword
